title: Every part in its place.

shareHint: The link includes selected components, quantities, positions, market and language.

adminIntro: From draft to the next build.
adminLoginHint: Use NoX Login to manage components, markets and content.
adminNotConfigured: NoX Login is not configured on this host yet. The public configurator remains available.

adminEmpty: There are no components in this view yet.

adminLocaleHint: Preserve parameters inside double braces in translations.
adminDirtyHint: Would you like to keep editing or discard these changes?
adminConfirmPublishHint: This changes the components or settings visitors see.

adminUploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Images become public only when used by a published component.
adminRoleHint: New administrators admitted by NoX Auth receive owner access. You can restrict their local role; this choice persists across logins and central admission is still required.
adminDelegationHint: Each access is bounded by your NoX session, chosen expiry and assigned permissions. Sign-out or revocation blocks new calls.
adminTokenOnce: This token is shown only now. Save it in the MCP client; do not share it publicly.
adminNoAudit: No changes have been recorded yet.

adminError_forbidden: Your account does not have permission for this action.

adminError_last_owner: You cannot remove the last owner.

adminEmptyEditor: Choose a component or create a new one.
